source.title: GPTQ: Accurate Post-Training Quantization for Generative Pre-trained Transformers

license.changes: Cropped from the original figure. Source colors and geometry are preserved.

teaching.spokenAnchor: Use a separate supplied matrix worksheet: E has two rows of normalized column errors. Its cross-block factor maps those errors into three later columns. Within a block, each rounded column changes the weights that remain free. After the block, accumulated corrections update later columns with matrix multiplication. This lazy batching changes when deferred work executes while retaining the dependency of each rounding decision on earlier corrections. It does not make all columns independent, and the tiny CPU calculation does not measure the full GPU quantizer’s runtime.
teaching.moment: Map sequential rounding inside a block and accumulated compensation into later columns.
teaching.scope: Use the procedure schematic rather than the performance chart; fixed order and deferred updates do not make columns independent.
teaching.caption: Round columns inside a block and compensate the remaining weights.
